name: smodin
headline: Smodin: Social Media Automation
short_description: Social Media Automation System - Prized personal project which is still in development, design interface screen shot included.
author: KevinDanikowski

sections.overview:
Smodin is a social media automation system that helps businesses create and schedule social posts without manual daily management. Users add their social profiles (Facebook, LinkedIn, Twitter), select an industry, answer business parameters, and receive auto-populated, ready-to-use posts. The platform includes a rewriter tool to quickly adapt posts for future reuse, and flexible scheduling options—by week, month, or randomized patterns. The main benefit is creating a full year of scheduled social content within one hour of setup.
Generate and schedule 12 months of social media content in under an hour
Maintain consistent posting across Facebook, LinkedIn, and Twitter without daily effort
Rewrite existing posts for multiple uses without creating new content from scratch
Create industry-specific posts with pre-populated parameters tailored to your business
